It's a size rule, not clear-bags-only. Arsenal's matchday safety page says bags must be smaller than A4, and it gives a small rucksack or handbag as examples. Bags get searched and tagged at entry. The page doesn't mention clear bags. Older Arsenal pages said A5 or clear, so a small bag is safest. https://www.arsenal.com/matchday-safety-and-security
